meta.title: Recruitment Division — DISHA + SOLVIQ | HireKarma
meta.description: Campus placement, fixed from both ends. DISHA runs the placement drive; SOLVIQ prepares students for the interviews they haven't had yet.

hero.heading: Campus placement is broken in most of India.
hero.description: We built two products to fix it from both ends — DISHA runs the placement drive from job posting to offer letter, and SOLVIQ prepares students for the interviews they have not yet had.

subCards.heading: Two products, one division
subCards.description: The brochure frames DISHA and SOLVIQ as the outputs of our Recruitment Division — one runs the operation, the other builds the candidate.

items.name: DISHA
items.tagline: The platform that runs the placement drive — from job posting to offer letter.
items.description: College engagement and placement enablement, with live visibility for TPOs across every drive.

items.name: SOLVIQ
items.tagline: The AI that prepares students for the interviews they have not yet had.
items.description: Resume scoring, skill tests, and mock interviews that close the gap between classroom and shortlist.

items.description: Track shortlists, results, and offer letters end to end.

bulletGroups.heading: What changes when a college uses DISHA
items: Up to 80% less coordination time for placement cells during peak season.
NAAC / AICTE-compatible placement reports generated from real data.
A single source of truth shared by students, TPOs, and recruiters.
Faster offer cycles with automated tracking and notifications.
Live visibility for management — no more chasing scattered updates.

meta.title: Skill Development Division — CSR Livelihood Training | HireKarma
meta.description: CSR-funded skilling that reaches young people where quality training was never built. 5,880+ youth trained across 20+ districts with a 78%+ placement rate.

hero.heading: Some of the most capable young people in India have no access to quality training.
hero.description: Not because they don't want to learn, but because it was never built for where they live. We partner with CSR and government funders to change that — community by community.

process.label: How it works
process.heading: From community to career, in six steps
process.description: A repeatable model that turns CSR funding into measurable livelihoods.

steps.title: Identify communities
steps.description: Find the districts and communities where capable youth lack access to training.

steps.title: CSR partnership
steps.description: Partner with corporate and PSU funders to underwrite the programme.

steps.title: Curriculum design
steps.description: Build industry-aligned curricula for the roles that are actually hiring.

steps.title: Run batches
steps.description: Deliver hands-on training close to where learners live.

steps.title: Issue verifiable certificates
steps.description: Certify completion with credentials that travel with the learner.

steps.title: Post-placement follow-up
steps.description: Track outcomes and support learners after they're placed.

meta.title: Pre-Placement Training Division | HireKarma
meta.description: Practitioner-led, on-campus pre-placement training that runs 4–8 weeks before placement season — aptitude, technical prep, communication, and mock interviews.

hero.heading: We embed inside colleges for 4–8 weeks before placement season.
hero.description: Our trainers are practitioners, not visiting lecturers — so students walk into placement drives ready for the questions that actually get asked.

cardSections.label: Programme structure
cardSections.heading: Four modules that cover the whole funnel

items.title: Aptitude & Reasoning
items.description: Quantitative, logical, and verbal reasoning for placement tests.

items.title: Technical Interview Prep
items.description: Core CS and role-specific technical rounds.

items.title: Communication & Soft Skills
items.description: Clear, confident communication under pressure.

items.title: HR Rounds & Mock Interviews
items.description: Realistic HR rounds and full mock interviews.

callout.heading: Every PPT programme runs alongside SOLVIQ
callout.text: Classroom coaching is reinforced with AI-driven practice — students get unlimited mock interviews and instant feedback between sessions.

bulletGroups.heading: How a typical engagement runs
items: 30–60 hours of training delivered over 4–6 weeks.
Parallel SOLVIQ sessions for unlimited practice between classes.
1:1 coaching for students who need targeted support.
Post-programme analytics so the college can see readiness improve.
